en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a waterfront city with canals and islands. At center is a large school complex of several connected, light‑colored buildings around an open courtyard. Rooftops and a towered building appear in the foreground; trees, fields, and the sea with islets are in the distance. The lower left caption reads "Kalmar läroverk." A publisher line at bottom right mentions a bookstore in Kalmar and there is an oval mark reading "AKTA FOTOGRAFI."
